SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). Keep her face soft, feminine and attractive in every framing — never elongated, gaunt, mannish or heavy-jawed, even in close-ups, profiles or low angles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a square 1:1 (1024×1024) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image.

ERA: a present-day place where the Three Kingdoms is remembered — a museum of Han relics, a restored plank road, the Red Cliffs park, an old city wall, a Chengdu teahouse, the Wuhou Shrine, a Guan Yu temple, Baidicheng, the Changban Bridge, a film set, an opera dressing room, a calligraphy class or a festival street.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze, a low rail, benches and cliffs sliding past
Weather / season: a rainy day — rain falls outside and streaks any window; surfaces are wet where she is outdoors.
Time of day: an overcast day — soft, shadowless grey-white light; the rain-wet ground mirroring the light around her.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a leather work apron over a sleeveless fitted top and slim work trousers, gauntlet gloves tucked in the belt — in deep amethyst purple; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a slightly cropped cut and a small enamel brooch on the lapel or neckline
POSTURE: standing at a waist-high railing or sill.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on the railing — her near arm, on the camera side; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a jade seal box at chest height; it is all she holds.
SIGNATURE ITEM SHAPE: it is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: a level, steady look, mouth closed. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive. Her eyes are naturally open and clear, not heavy-lidded or half-closed; brows relaxed and even, neither raised on one side nor furrowed; lips softly closed or only just parted.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — inside the crop, the chosen outfit is worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders and collarbones, skin clearly showing; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; the part of that outfit inside the crop must read at first glance in its own colours. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her mecha-world identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
